limitations: All NCGR/NCLR files are host prototypes; no SDK reader executed. Single-bank NCLR is unpadded, not native shared NCLR.
PC checks verify the first 512 character bytes inside the 640-byte read prefix, not that the truncated prefix is a valid standalone NCGR.
Shade transformation changes index-zero palette word like upstream; transparency remains controlled by index zero, not RGB.
No source art approvals, native palette allocation, species IDs or resource member IDs.
